description.en: The words Granny Maggie says every day, at home, on the farm and in the village: to be and was, to have, to do, to go, to come, can, to say, to get, to take, to see, to like; old and good; there, here, up, now, then, again, so, how and not. And love, as everyone is called in the north.
description.sl: Besede, ki jih babica Maggie reče vsak dan, doma, na kmetiji in v vasi: biti, imeti, delati, iti, priti, moči, reči, dobiti, vzeti, videti, imeti rad; star in dober; tam, tukaj, gor, zdaj, potem, spet, tako, kako in ne. In love, kot na severu rečejo vsakomur.
description.de: Die Wörter, die Granny Maggie jeden Tag sagt, zu Hause, auf dem Hof und im Dorf: sein, haben, machen, gehen, kommen, können, sagen, bekommen, nehmen, sehen, mögen; alt und gut; dort, hier, hinauf, jetzt, dann, wieder, so, wie und nicht. Und love, wie man im Norden alle nennt.
description.it: Le parole che Granny Maggie dice ogni giorno, a casa, in fattoria e in paese: essere, avere, fare, andare, venire, potere, dire, ricevere, prendere, vedere, piacere; vecchio e buono; lì, qui, su, adesso, poi, di nuovo, così, come e non. E love, come al nord si chiama chiunque.
